title: Big Breakfast — Church Lench Village Hall
body: Start your Saturday with a hearty village breakfast, served from 9 to 10.30am: a full English, Danish pastries, fresh fruit, and toast and preserves, with tea, coffee, juice or bubbles. Tickets £10, or £5 for under-12s, from any Village Hall Committee member. Everyone welcome.

image.alt: Flyer for the Big Breakfast at Church Lench Village Hall, Saturday 24 October, serving 9 to 10.30am, tickets £10 or £5 for under-12s
